body:
Merged upstream main into the contributor branch after #3205 merged. The only manual resolution was the generated MCP reference. The compiled reference includes the upstream and Agie tools.

The PR body records the results for `d982d452b`. All 104 targeted tests and strict all-target Clippy passed. A fresh export reproduced the six controller-checked files. The 254-step heavy gate is in progress. The PR remains a draft while it runs.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d982d452be45cc8a123906b0e73311126f384020 -->
Not built - needs a maintainer look. No blocking source finding. This is not a verified build or a safety clearance.

What looks good:

- Creation uses the undoable operation command. CLI, MCP and desktop export use the same application entry point.
- Export checks the selected source, threading disk, rounded topology, arc extrema and mounted travel before publication.
- The native script deletes working steps and does not create them. The receipt identifies unverified holding, leads and erosion settings.
- The body includes before and after desktop screenshots. The partial work uses `Refs #3178` and `Refs #3179`.

Local results:

- The trial merge with upstream/main at `ced4dc34e743b75a2e6d7836c998dcc5f2c1fa79` completed without conflicts.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...review-3219` passed.
- Build, quick gate, touched suites and Clippy: not run. `crates/post/Cargo.toml:21` adds direct dependencies on `tempfile`, `rustix` and `windows-sys`. The reviewer rules require a maintainer decision before a build of this dependency change. `Cargo.lock` also changes.
- No GitHub runner or workflow was used.

Extra suites run:

- None. The dependency rule prevented test execution.
- No fixture or golden directory changes. No moved goldens require a line review.
- The diff does not change the STEP, mesh or model import code. The additional kernel import suites do not apply.

Safety verification:

- This change affects geometry and native controller output. It requires the safety tier.
- Reviewer mutations: not run because of the dependency rule. No red/green mutation result is claimed.
- The author reports 104 targeted tests, strict Clippy and 254 passing heavy steps on this head. These are author results, not reviewer results.
- After the dependency decision, local tests and at least two safety mutations remain necessary before a verified clean review.

Requested source changes: none.

Maintainer decision: inspect the dependency additions and the platform publication code in `crates/post/src/agie_setup/publish.rs`. The review label is `needs-maintainer`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22: the Agie stack goes one PR at a time, after #2951.

- The approvals for #2951 carry over to this PR: the direct dependencies `tempfile`, `rustix` and `windows-sys` in `crates/post`, and the Agie-CAM reference (MIT).
- This PR gets its own independent safety read and a trial-merge gate after #2951 merges.
- #2993 and #2999 stay drafts until their turn. They are refreshed then.

The label `needs-maintainer` is removed.

Coordinator: I removed `needs-maintainer`. It was set again at 16:33Z with no comment and no named reason.

The recorded decision on this PR stands (comment 7080044891, "Maintainer decision, 2026-11-22: the Agie stack goes one PR at a time, after #2951"):
- The approvals for #2951 carry over to this PR: the direct dependencies `tempfile`, `rustix` and `windows-sys` in `crates/post`, and the Agie-CAM reference (MIT).
- This PR gets its own independent safety read and a trial-merge gate after #2951 merges.

No owner decision is open here. If you see a change that the decision does not cover, name it in a comment. A label with a named reason stays.

Coordinator, a rule for this PR and the PRs stacked on it (#2993, #2999 and those after them).

The maintainer reported #3537: the word "Agie" shows in text that the user reads as if it were a feature, an operation or a post type. Agie is a machine. The dialects are Klartext and ISO wire EDM. The posted output and the goldens must not change. The machine file and the model name stay.

Thus:
- This PR does not merge before the naming plan of #3537 is known, unless the text that it adds is only on the machine side (a machine file, a model name).
- When the rename of #3537 merges, we tell you here which names changed, so that this branch can take them.
- The other steps of the recorded decision (comment 7080044891) stay: an independent safety read and a trial-merge gate, one PR at a time. #2951 merged at 17:40Z, so the chain is on `main` now.

@qsmits no action is needed from you now. If you plan new user-facing text in this stack, use the machine name only where the text names the machine.
